historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly keeps operator observation but substitutes a different LED trigger and omits physical/data safety.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Separates passive presence behavior from Locate control and requires platform semantics plus complete mapping/log evidence.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row98 owns I/O-driven Access/Busy indication; this row observes Present/power after insertion and must not use activity or Locate as a proxy.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The passive physical state must be correlated to the exact drive, controller enclosure and bay without altering unrelated indicators.

original_test_intent: Verify that inserting the approved NVMe SSD into the specified RAID-card/backplane bay produces the platform-defined Present/power LED state without unexpected storage or management errors.
original_method: A qualified operator performs the supported insertion and records the physical LED state/timing while the agent correlates the exact serial, enclosure, slot and controller identities and captures complete read-only health/log evidence.
manual_activity: User approves the LED specification and insertion/recovery matrix; qualified operator inserts the exact SSD and photographs the indicator; agent collects read-only mapping and health evidence.
required_inputs: Platform Present/power LED state, color, timing and applicability
Stable NVMe ID to enclosure/slot/backplane/controller mapping
Supported hot-swap or powered-off insertion and ESD procedure
Qualified operator, camera, secure controller/BMC access and OOB
safety_requirements: Verify exact drive/bay identity and insertion support before physical action
Protect mounts, RAID, boot and data state and preserve complete logs
Do not assume controller indices or Locate semantics
Stop on wrong bay, insertion resistance, unexpected LED, enumeration mismatch, RAID/filesystem/thermal/power/BMC error or access loss
Do not issue blind Locate/clear, reseat, rebuild or reboot automatically
agent_execution_scope: Capture empty/baseline and post-insertion stable drive-enclosure-slot-controller mapping
Collect complete RAID/mount/NVMe/health and OS/BMC logs
Run only approved read-only controller query as corroboration
Do not insert hardware, claim visual confirmation, manipulate an indicator or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve LED semantics, exact mapping, insertion/data and recovery procedure
Provide a qualified operator and decide whether any controller query is equivalent
Review physical plus system evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: storcli Locate can address an indicator but does not establish passive Present/power behavior and an assumed /c0/e/s target may select the wrong bay.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secure read-only enclosure/slot/controller and NVMe identity/health queries around the operator insertion; use an LED-state command only when vendor documentation maps it to the same Present/power signal.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe insertion, Present LED check and source 5/5 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join a timestamped physical Present/power observation to exact controller enclosure/slot and SSD identity, with complete post-insertion health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents a Locate command from being accepted as the tested passive indication and adds safe insertion/recovery boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation corroborates mapping and health only; it does not replace the physical observation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some platforms combine power, presence and activity in one LED; only the approved vendor state table can define expected behavior.

project_override_considerations: If the RAID controller virtualizes enclosure numbering or exposes no reliable slot property, operator label/serial evidence remains necessary and the agent must report mapping ambiguity.
expected_evidence: Operator identity, insertion method/time and physical LED photos
Stable SSD serial/NGUID to controller/enclosure/slot mapping
Complete dmesg/syslog/SEL/BMC and any approved read-only LED query
Final state/recovery notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines a Present LED check. DeepSeek's Locate suggestion is an incomplete/non-equivalent method rather than a source ambiguity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: LED specification, mapping and operator are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Separates passive Present/power indication from Locate control and binds the physical result to exact RAID enclosure and SSD identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: A controller Locate operation follows an explicit management-control path, whereas Present/power indication is normally driven by slot occupancy and power state. The same lamp may be shared but that cannot be assumed; therefore the operator-visible state table and insertion event are primary, while controller enumeration only verifies which device and bay participated.
